analogy.rationale: SELP (P-selectin) is an adhesion molecule expressed on activated platelets and endothelial cells, not a transcriptional regulator; these cell lines are not platelets or activated endothelium, so a P-selectin inhibitor should produce little to no transcriptional response. Other classes targeting platelet/endothelial adhesion or inflammatory mediators are the closest but still expected to be largely inactive in these cells.
